description: Copy another trader's moves, on your own size.

SIZING.description: how much per copy — a fixed dollar figure, a share of your own cash, or a share of what they trade?

MAX_USD.description: per-trade ceiling; set only when the owner named one

MAX_PER_DAY.description: at most this many opening trades (buys, perp opens) per UTC day; exits are never capped

MAX_USD_PER_DAY.description: at most this many dollars into opening trades per UTC day (a perp counts its margin); set only when the owner named one

CHAIN_IDS.description: empty = the leader's chain; set only when specified

MIN_LEADER_USD.description: ignore leader trades smaller than this

MIRROR_PERPS.description: copy the leader's perp opens and closes, at your own leverage

MIRROR_STOCKS.description: copy the leader's tokenized-stock buys and sells

PERP_LEVERAGE.description: leverage for a copied perp open; 0 = use the leader's own

PERP_MAX_LEVERAGE.description: cap on the leverage of a copied open; 0 = no cap (the venue's 50x still applies)
